title: Contactless Detection of pH Change in a Liquid Analyte
content: We describe an experiment in which we employ a radiofrequency sensor to measure pH changes in a liquid solution. The experiment is novel in a few ways. First, the sensor does not have contact with the liquid, but rather detects the change from the outside of a PVC pipe. Second, the change is detected using a Linear Discriminant Analysis model using values from an inverse Fourier transform of the frequency data as its features. We believe this to be the first use of Fourier anaylsis in contactless pH measurement using radio frequencies.
